hero.description: A complete digital platform to manage merchandising and field execution inside stores with real-time tracking, verified proof of execution, and a secure payment system that protects all parties.

about.title: What is ShelfSpot?
about.subtitle: ShelfSpot is a specialized digital platform designed to manage and execute in-store merchandising tasks efficiently.
about.paragraphOne: We connect companies with trained field merchandisers to ensure promotions and shelf displays are executed accurately, on time, and with full transparency.
about.paragraphTwo: Our mission is to improve in-store execution quality across the Saudi market through technology that delivers speed, reliability, and visibility.

secure.title: Secure Payments
secure.description: Payments are released only after task approval.

assignment.description: We assign the best-matched merchandiser based on location and task type.

review.title: Review & Approval
review.description: You review the results and approve the task. Payment is released automatically.

footer.description: A digital platform for managing and executing in-store field tasks, providing companies with clear operational visibility and a reliable execution mechanism across various regions of the Kingdom.
